stories.headline: Green Party delivers historic by-election victory, pushing Labour to third place in Gorton and Denton
stories.summary: The Green Party won their first-ever parliamentary by-election in Gorton and Denton, with Hannah Spencer defeating Reform UK and pushing Labour into third place in what had been a safe Labour seat for nearly a century. The result is seen as a major blow to Keir Starmer's leadership.
